issue: Battery IDs not physically tracked (packs 'teleport' between cities)
detection_method: Same pack issued in 2 cities ≤60 min apart; returned pack vs last issued pack per rider
decision: Per-pack SoH valid; per-pack location / rotation / turnaround NOT valid
impact_on_kpis: 239,049 re-issues of a pack in another city within 60 min (44,274 within 10 min); riders return the pack they were last given only 0.03% of the time.

issue: Peak/off-peak adjustments hidden inside PARTNER tariff code
detection_method: Row identity amount = list − discount; residual +15/−8 by partner flag, city, period
decision: Derive pilot exposure from the residual, not tariff_code
impact_on_kpis: 163,312 partner swaps carry the +15 surcharge and 69,952 the −8 discount, on the true PEAK/OFFPEAK hours 100%/99.97% of the time, while coded PARTNER: tariff_code labels none of them (misses 100% of partner exposure). They are 43.0% of post-pilot partner swaps in Bengaluru/Pune (64.8% of Y-flag partners' swaps) and 54.0% of all 432,019 pilot-priced swaps; N-flag partners never charged. Net INR 1.89M.

issue: Firmware v3.2.0 timestamp bug (10-Mar..14-Apr-2025)
detection_method: Hour profile vs v3.2.1 stations in same weeks; true pilot tariff schedule as independent clock; 30-min edge bins; row-level tariff contradictions
decision: Shift +5h30m (clean.py)
impact_on_kpis: Untreated: 18.6% of v3.2.0 attempts at 00-05h (true 3.5%); network 12-22h share 65.7% vs 76.4% in window; PEAK rows inside true PEAK hours (12-13h, 19-22h) 11.6% raw vs 100.0% fixed; code-schedule agreement 10.4% vs 100.0%. Edge: ~147 attempts of 10-Mar 00:00-05:29 left unshifted, 16 of them identified row by row (logged 9-Mar evening, billed OFFPEAK).

issue: Packs below the 70% EOL SoH still issued (incl. 'retired' packs after 15-Jun-2025)
detection_method: SoH of issued packs vs 70% EOL; join issued pack to retired_date; wear cost charged on those swaps
decision: Keep (real swaps); flag; treat retirement record as administrative; size wear-past-EOL as a cm1 sensitivity
impact_on_kpis: 122,204 swaps issued sub-70% packs (first 2025-04-03, all Kyron); 33,761 came after retirement, using 1,438 'retired' packs at median SoH 61.8%. The cost model charges INR 12.9M of wear on them (INR 105.5/swap); without it cm1/swap would be +12.4 (May-25) and +18.0 (Jun-25) instead of -5.4 / -5.0.
impact_short: 122,204 sub-EOL swaps; ₹12.9M wear charged past EOL

issue: Test stations STN-TST-01/02 hold full paid activity
detection_method: station_id prefix; compare value/hours vs documentation
decision: Exclude from all KPIs (kept in test_station_events.parquet)
impact_on_kpis: Kept in: Bengaluru revenue +8.2%, network revenue +1.7% (INR 3.93M), Bengaluru failure rate 4.11%→4.12%, Bengaluru growth 3.16x→3.06x; only 2,897 zero-value rows (all non-completed) and a normal night share (3.8%) — they behave like a real Bengaluru station (1,643 vs 1,656 swaps/station-month) used by 3,300 real riders, so the exclusion is a labelled-asset decision, not an obvious-junk one.

issue: Telemetry blanks (telemetry_status = missing)
detection_method: Null profile by status x connectivity tier; zero-fill simulation; outcome test in blank hours
decision: Keep null; null-aware means; report coverage
impact_on_kpis: All blanks at poor-tier stations (100%). Zero-fill would add 9,384 fake stockout-hours (network x1.51, poor tier x4.44) and cut poor-tier stock level by 4.0%. Blank hours are not worse for riders (stockout 3.72% vs 3.68% when reported).

issue: Packs used before recorded commission date
detection_method: first_seen in swaps vs batteries.commission_date / manufacture_date
decision: Age from first_seen; ignore commission_date
impact_on_kpis: 79% of packs used a median 191 days before commissioning (4,506 even before manufacture) — commission-based age would be negative.
impact_short: pack age from commission_date wrong for 79% of packs

issue: CSAT mostly missing, not at random
detection_method: Response rate by speed decile/status; logistic response model; IPW + post-stratification
decision: Report IPW/post-stratified CSAT for resolved tickets + bound for unresolved
impact_on_kpis: Naive 3.56 vs IPW 3.56 (post-strat 3.56, CI 3.54-3.58): re-weighting barely moves it because scores vary little with speed; the real gap is the 5,163 unresolved tickets with 0% response (scenario: population CSAT 3.26-3.50 if they scored 1-3; unrestricted range 3.26-3.74).
impact_short: naive 3.56 vs IPW 3.56; scenario with unresolved 3.26–3.50

issue: Season labels (Summer = Mar–May) misaligned with the Apr–Jun heat regime
detection_method: Daily failure rate; 7-day steps at month boundaries vs mid-month control; city weather and station ambient temperature; cross-city contrast
decision: Control seasonality with city-month temperature (or city x month effects), not SEASON_OF_MONTH
impact_on_kpis: Failure rate steps on the 1st of Apr/May/Jun/Jul because the weather is month-level: mean city max temp steps +8.7/+6.5/-4.1/-11.7 C on the same days (≤0.65 C around the 16th). The 1-Jul-24 drop (9.6%→3.7%) happened only in hot cities; cool cities under the same price rise moved -0.8 to +0.1 pts -> heat, not price. March ('Summer') runs 3.9%, June ('Monsoon') 9.9%: season dummies blur the regime.
impact_short: failures track month-level heat (>~34–36 °C), not season labels

issue: Ticket category 'other' hides vehicle/battery complaints
detection_method: Distinct comment templates per category
decision: Re-classify via comment text (ticket-text analysis)
impact_on_kpis: All 9,484 'other' tickets are 3 vehicle-blaming templates ('bike problem lag raha hai overall', ...) — likely range/battery issues mis-filed.
impact_short: 22% of tickets in an uninformative 'other' bucket

issue: PREPAID / PROMO_FREE tariff codes absent; prepaid riders pay standard tariffs
detection_method: Code inventory vs data dictionary; tariff by plan_type
decision: Treat plan_type as a label; no prepaid discount modelled
impact_on_kpis: 372,083 prepaid_pack swaps billed exactly like pay-as-you-go (same tariffs, discount 0) — prepaid revenue cannot be separated.

issue: 3W swaps at stations with zero 3W slots
detection_method: Event vehicle class vs stations.slots_3w
decision: Flag; do not use slots_3w / inventory_target_3w for 3W capacity
impact_on_kpis: 83 stations list 0 3W slots yet serve 237,310 3W attempts (3W share 11.0% vs 10.7% elsewhere, same stockout rate) — slot metadata does not constrain 3W activity; swaps_per_slot_day and 3W capacity metrics are unreliable.
impact_short: 237K 3W attempts at 0-slot stations; capacity metrics unreliable

issue: Price fields populated on non-completed attempts
detection_method: amount vs list/discount by event_type
decision: Revenue = amount_charged on completed swaps only
impact_on_kpis: Using list − discount on every attempt would overstate revenue by INR 15.0M (+6.6%).

issue: riders.home_city inconsistent spellings
detection_method: Value list; cross-check vs home_zone prefix (0 mismatches)
decision: Map 21 spellings → 6 cities
impact_on_kpis: Raw exact-match counts undercount cities by 2.6–3.7%; 585 riders would fall into 15 phantom 'cities'.

issue: km_since_last_swap outliers (odometer resets)
detection_method: Value range; empty gap 120-330 km; rider dispersion test
decision: Set to null (<0 or >200 km), flag km_invalid
impact_on_kpis: 2W mean 58.5→58.1 km, sd 18.0→10.8; 3W mean 89.9→89.6; medians unchanged; spread evenly across riders (dispersion 0.97) and suppliers.

issue: payment_mode constant ('partner_invoice' on 100%)
detection_method: Distinct values (also for pay-as-you-go riders)
decision: Drop field; use plan_type/tariff
impact_on_kpis: No payment-channel analysis possible.

issue: station_firmware is static per station (not 'firmware at event time')
detection_method: Distinct firmware per station over time vs stations.firmware_updated_date
decision: Use only as station attribute; no pre/post firmware comparisons
impact_on_kpis: All 150 stations carry one value for 18 months; 1,083,456 attempts are labelled v3.2.0 before it was installed.
impact_short: firmware field cannot date firmware changes

issue: Riders without KYC verification swapping
detection_method: riders.kyc_verified vs activity
decision: Keep; flag for compliance
impact_on_kpis: 746 unverified riders made 139,764 completed swaps.

issue: Telemetry 'partial' status rows
detection_method: Null profile by telemetry_status
decision: Treat as usable
impact_on_kpis: 36,747 'partial' rows have every field populated; only 'missing' rows are blank.

issue: Tickets outside window / at test stations / before sign-up
detection_method: created_ts vs window, station is_test, rider signup
decision: Exclude from in-window ticket KPIs (flags in_window, is_test)
impact_on_kpis: 86 outside Jan-24..Jun-25, 535 at test stations, 40 before the rider signed up (52 before first attempt).

issue: Unexplained ±₹5/±₹10 billing deviations
detection_method: Residual after documented tariff rules
decision: Keep amount_charged as revenue; flag for billing audit
impact_on_kpis: Net INR 7,961 (gross INR 59,049); billing-dispute ticket within 7 d 0.83% vs 0.87% for normal swaps.

issue: SoC/SoH readings >100% (sensor drift)
detection_method: Range check (max 103.0%); by-month share; station dispersion within a fixed period
decision: Clip at 100, flag reading_clipped
impact_on_kpis: Mean issued-pack SoH moves by 0.0002 pts. Readings >100 fade from 4.65% of attempts (Jan-24) to 0.09% (Jun-25) as packs age; within Q1-2024 they are spread across stations like chance (dispersion 1.06) -> drift on new packs, no faulty cabinets, no KPI impact.

issue: queue_wait_sec hard caps (1,800 s completed / 2,400 s abandoned)
detection_method: Point mass at the maximum by event type
decision: Keep; treat as right-censored; report medians/p90
impact_on_kpis: 143 completed swaps at exactly 1800 s and 34 abandons at 2400 s; p99 waits (754/1642 s) sit below the caps, so means/p90 are unaffected.

issue: Near-duplicate offline-sync retries
detection_method: Documented rule + 6 looser definitions; gap-distribution, offline-share and same-battery tests
decision: None removed (rule applied, 0 hits)
impact_on_kpis: 0 duplicates under the documented rule and none under any looser rule: the same station + type rule (D2) finds 5,633 pairs (0.148%) with a flat gap density (0-120 s vs 120-600 s ratio 1.00) and no offline_batch excess (24.3% vs 24.1% expected); only 6 same-battery_in pairs ≤300 s exist network-wide (3.8 expected by chance) -> chance coincidences, not retries. Dropping D2 pairs anyway would cut swaps by 0.16% and move the failure rate 5.553%→5.561%.
impact_short: 0 duplicates; looser rules ≤0.17% & look like chance

issue: Energy-to-recharge vs SoC/SoH/capacity consistency
detection_method: Ratio of grid kWh to kWh needed per swap; by charger generation
decision: No action (energy cost per swap trustworthy)
impact_on_kpis: r = 0.982; median 1.10 grid kWh per kWh needed (p01–p99 0.85–1.38); 719 rows outside 0.7–1.6. Efficiency rises with charger generation (Gen1 1.128, Gen2 1.077, Gen3 1.044).
impact_short: consistent (r = 0.98); Gen1 uses 8% more energy than Gen3

issue: Integrity checks: events before sign-up / commissioning, after decommissioning, pack-vs-vehicle class
detection_method: Date and class cross-checks on every attempt
decision: No action
impact_on_kpis: 0 violations in all four checks — rider/station timelines are consistent.
